detail.longDescription: OpenAI is rolling out new models all the time, and you can see the improvements and power even in a quick back-and-forth with ChatGPT. But as much as we all love shooting the breeze with an AI chatbot, the real question is how you can put the AI models to use in your work. All of ChatGPT's state-of-the-art models are available in Zapier. That means you can add ChatGPT-powered steps to your existing workflows, or securely access and take action in apps directly from ChatGPT, without ever leaving
